knowledge_point.title: Determining the Dimensions of a Matrix

question.:question/problem:
Chelsea represents information using the following matrix:
$P = \begin{bmatrix}0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0\end{bmatrix}$
The dimensions of $P$ are {{field-1}} $\times$ {{field-2}}.
question.:question/worked-solution: The matrix $P$ has $2$ rows and $2$ columns. Therefore, its dimensions are $2\times 2.$
